Treasury Analyst Intern

Company: Beacon Harbour Credit Union
Location: Moncton, NB
Work Arrangement: On-site
Work Term: Summer 2028
Duration: 4 months
Salary: $24.75 per hour
Application Deadline: 05/04/2028

About the Role

Beacon Harbour Credit Union is a member-owned financial institution. The Treasury Analyst
Intern will support cash management and liquidity reporting.

Responsibilities

- Prepare daily cash position and liquidity reports
- Support treasury settlement and reconciliation processes
- Assist with investment portfolio reporting
